English: I have had severe chest pain and fever for two days.
Amharic: ለሁለት ቀናት ከባድ የደረት ህመም እና ትኩሳት ነበረኝ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Guyyoota lamaaf dhukkubbiin qomaa cimaanii fi qaama gubaan natti hammaateera.
Tigrinya: ንኽልተ መዓልታት ዝጸንሐ ጽኑዕ ናይ ኣፍልቢ ሕማምን ረስንን ነይሩኒ።
Somali: Waxaan laba maalmood qabay laab xanuun daran iyo qandho xoog leh.

English: Are you experiencing any vaginal bleeding or labor contractions?
Amharic: ምንም አይነት የደም መፍሰስ ወይም የምጥ ስሜት ይሰማዎታል?
Afaan_Oromoo: Dhiigni qaama saalaa dhangala'u yookaan ciniinsuun dhukkubaa si mudateeraa?
Tigrinya: ምፍሳስ ደም ወይስ ስምዒት ምጥ የጋጥመክን ኣሎ ዶ?
Somali: Ma dareemaysaa wax dhiig bax ah ama xanuunka foolasha?

English: The child has acute shortness of breath and cannot swallow liquids.
Amharic: ህጻኑ ከፍተኛ የትንፋሽ ማጠር ስላለበት ፈሳሽ ነገር መዋጥ አይችልም።
Afaan_Oromoo: Daa'imichi hafuura baafachuu baay'ee dadhabeera, dhangala'oos liqimsuu hin danda'u.
Tigrinya: እቲ ሕፃን ጽኑዕ ሕጽረት ትንፋስ ስለዘለዎ ፈሳሲ ነገር ምውሓጥ ኣይክእልን እዩ።
Somali: Ilmaha waxaa haya neef-qabasho daran wax dareere ahna ma liqi karo.

English: Do not take this medication on an empty stomach.
Amharic: ይህንን መድሃኒት በባዶ ሆድ በፍጹም እንዳይወስዱ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Qoricha kana garaa duwwaatti tasuma hin fudhatinaa.
Tigrinya: ነዚ መድሃኒት እዚ ብጥሙይ ከብዲ ፈጺምኩም ኣይትውሰድዎ።
Somali: Daawadan ha ku qaadanin calool madhan.

English: Inject 15 units of insulin subcutaneously thirty minutes before breakfast.
Amharic: ቁርስ ከመብላትዎ ሰላሳ ደቂቃ በፊት 15 ዩኒት ኢንሱሊን በቆዳ ስር ይውጉ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Ciree nyaachuun dura daqiiqaa soddoma dura yuuniitii 15 inasuliinii gogaa jalaan waraanaadhaa.
Tigrinya: ቁርሲ ቅድሚ ምብላዕኩም ሰላሳ ደቒቕ ኣቐዲምኩም 15 ዩኒት ኢንሱሊን ኣብ ትሕቲ ቆርበት ተወግኡ።
Somali: Iska mud 15 unug oo insuliin ah maqaarka hoostiisa soddon daqiiqo ka hor quraacda.

English: He had an epileptic seizure, bit his tongue, and lost consciousness.
Amharic: የሚጥል በሽታ አንቀጥቅጦት ምላሱን ነክሶ ራሱን ሳተ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Dhibeen gaggabdoo qabee arraba isaa ciniinee of wallaale.
Tigrinya: ናይ ምጥል ሕማም ሒዝዎ ልሳኑ ነኺሱ ነብሱ ሰሓተ።
Somali: Suuxdin baa ku dhacday, carabkiisana wuu qaniinay, miyirkana wuu ka tagay.

English: Are you allergic to penicillin or any other antibiotics?
Amharic: ለፔኒሲሊን ወይም ለሌሎች አንቲባዮቲኮች አለርጂ አለብዎት?
Afaan_Oromoo: Paanisiliinii yookaan qorichoota farra-baakteeriyaa biraatiif alarjiin si irra jiraa?
Tigrinya: ንፔኒሲሊን ወይስ ንኻልኦት ፀረ-ተህዋስያን ኣለርጂ ኣለኩም ዶ?
Somali: Xasaasiyad ma ku leedahay daawada baensiliinta ama dawooyinka kale ee antibiyootigga?

English: My leg is broken and I cannot put any weight on it.
Amharic: እግሬ ስለተሰበረ ምንም አይነት ክብደት ልጭንበት አልችልም።
Afaan_Oromoo: Miilli koo waan cabeef ulfaatina homaayyuu irra dhaabbachuu hin danda'u.
Tigrinya: እግረይ ስለእተሰብረ ዋላ ሓንቲ ኽብደት ክረግጸሉ ኣይኽእልን እየ።
Somali: Lugtayda way jabtay wax culeys ahna ma saari karo.

English: She is suffering from continuous watery diarrhea and severe dehydration.
Amharic: ተከታታይ የውሃ ተቅማጥ እና ከፍተኛ የሰውነት ፈሳሽ እጥረት አጋጥሟታል።
Afaan_Oromoo: Albaatiin bishaanii walirraa hin cinneefi qaamni bishaan dhabuun cimaan ishee mudateera.
Tigrinya: ቀጻሊ ናይ ማይ ውጽኣትን ጽኑዕ ምውሓድ ፈሳሲ ኣካላትን ኣጋጢምዋ ኣሎ።
Somali: Waxaa haya shuban biyo ah oo joogto ah iyo fuuq-bax daran.

English: Take a deep breath and push now!
Amharic: ረጅሙን ተንፍሺና አሁን አምጪ!
Afaan_Oromoo: Hafuura dheeraa fudhadhuutii ammumma ciniiniitii dhiibi!
Tigrinya: ዕሙቕ ዝበለ ትንፋስ ወሲድኪ ሕጂ ጽዓሪ!
Somali: Neef dheer qaado oo hadda riix!

English: When I heard the tragic news, I was moved to tears.
Amharic: አሳዛኙን ዜና ስሰማ ሆዴ ባባ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Oduu gaddisiisaa sana yeroon dhaga'u garaan koo baay'ee na laafe.
Tigrinya: ነቲ ዘሕዝን ዜና ምስ ሰማዕኩ ልበይ ሰንበደ።
Somali: Markii aan warka naxdinta leh maqlay, aad baan uga tiiraanyooday oo ilmeeyay.

English: When I saw the armed men, I ran as fast as my legs could carry me.
Amharic: ታጣቂዎቹን ሳያቸው እግር አውጣ ብዬ ሮጥኩ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Namoota meeshaa qabatan sana yeroon argu miila koo garaatti baadheen fiige.
Tigrinya: ነቶም ዕጡቓት ሰባት ምስ ርአኽዎም ብዘለኒ ሓይሊ ሃዲመ።
Somali: Markii aan arkay ragga hubaysan, xawli daran baan ku cararay.

English: I am speaking to you with all seriousness, do not joke.
Amharic: በቁም ነገር ነው የማናግርህ፣ አትቀልድ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Dhugumatti dubbii ulfaataadhaanan sitti himaa jira, hin taphatin.
Tigrinya: ብቐንዱ ብዕቱብ እየ ዝዛረበካ ዘለኹ፡ ኣይትዋዘ።
Somali: Si dhab ah oo miyir leh baan kuula hadlayaa, ha kaftamin.

English: The room is spinning and I feel very dizzy.
Amharic: አይኔ እየጨለመ ራሴን እያዞረኝ ነው።
Afaan_Oromoo: Lafti natti maraa jira, akkasumas sammuun na naanna'aa jira.
Tigrinya: ኣዒንተይ እናጸልመተ ርእሰይ የዕዘረኒ ኣሎ።
Somali: Dunnida ayaa igu wareegaysa aadna waan u wareersanahay.

English: When I heard that my child was safe, my heart was deeply relieved.
Amharic: ልጄ ሰላም መሆኑን ስሰማ ልቤ አረፈ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Mucaan koo nagaa ta'uu yeroon dhaga'u garaan koo tasgabbaa'e.
Tigrinya: ውላደይ ድሓን ምህላዉ ምስ ሰማዕኩ ልበይ ዓሪፉ።
Somali: Markii aan maqlay in ilmahaygii nabad qabo, wadnahaygu wuu degay oo nafi baa igu soo noqotay.

English: Be strong and stay courageous, everything will be alright.
Amharic: አይዞህ በርታ፣ ሁሉም ነገር በሰላም ያልፋል።
Afaan_Oromoo: Jabaadhu garaa jabeeffadhu, wanti hundi nagaan darba.
Tigrinya: ኣይትተሓለል ጽናዕ፡ ኵሉ ነገር ብሰላም ክሓልፍ እዩ።
Somali: Adkayso oo geesi noqo, wax walba way hagaagi doonaane.

English: Happy holiday and season's greetings to you and your family!
Amharic: እንኳን ለአዲሱ ዓመት በዓል በሰላም አደረሳችሁ!
Afaan_Oromoo: Baga ayyaana bara haaraatiin isiniifi maatii keessan nagaan geessan!
Tigrinya: እንቋዕ ናብዚ ሓዲሽ ዓመት በዓል ብሰላም ኣብጽሓኩም!
Somali: Kugu hambalyeeyay munaasabadda ciidda adiga iyo qoyskaagaba!

English: Thank you very much, and may God bless you with health.
Amharic: እግዚአብሔር ይስጥልኝ፣ ጤና ይስጥልኝ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Waaqayyo fayyaa fi umurii siif haa kennu, baay'ee galatoomi.
Tigrinya: እግዚኣብሄር ይሃበለይ፡ ጥዕና ይሃበለይ።
Somali: Ilaahay haku barakeeyo caafimaadna haku siiyo, aad baad u mahadsan tahay.

English: How much does a quintal of white Magna teff cost today?
Amharic: ዛሬ የአንድ ኩንታል የነጭ ማኛ ጤፍ ዋጋ ስንት ነው?
Afaan_Oromoo: Har'a gatiin xaafii adii maangaa kintaala tokkoo meeqa?
Tigrinya: ሎሚ ዋጋ ሓደ ኲንታል ጻዕዳ ጣፍ ክንደይ እዩ?
Somali: Immisaa maanta qiimaha hal kintaal oo ah daafi cad?

English: This Yirgacheffe washed coffee is of premium grade and very aromatic.
Amharic: ይህ የታጠበ የይርጋጨፌ ቡና አንደኛ ደረጃ እና እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ መዓዛ ያለው ነው።
Afaan_Oromoo: Buni Yirgaacaffaa miiccame kun qulqullina olaanaa fi foolii baay'ee gaarii qaba.
Tigrinya: እዚ ዝተሓጽበ ናይ ይርጋጨፈ ቡን ቀዳማይ ደረጃን ኣዝዩ ጥዑም ጨና ዘለዎን እዩ።
Somali: Bunkan Yirgaacheffe ee la dhaqay waa heerka koowaad aadna wuu u caraf badan yahay.

English: Ten thousand Birr is too expensive; please reduce the price for me.
Amharic: አስር ሺህ ብር በጣም ውድ ነው፤ እባክዎ ትንሽ ቀንስልኝ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Birriin kuma kudhan baay'ee mi'aawaadha; maaloo gatii naaf hir'isi.
Tigrinya: ዓሰርተ ሽሕ ቅርሺ ኣዝዩ ክቡር እዩ፤ በጃኻ ዋጋ ኣጉድለለይ።
Somali: Toban kun oo Birr aad bay qaali u tahay; fadlan qiimaha wax iiga dhim.

English: How much for this fat sheep for the holiday feast?
Amharic: ለበዓሉ ድግስ የሚሆነው ይህ የሰባ በግ ስንት ነው?
Afaan_Oromoo: Hoolaan gabbataaniifi nyaata ayyaanaatiif ta'u kun gatiin isaa meeqa?
Tigrinya: ንበዓል ድግሲ ዝኸውን እዚ ዝሰበሐ በጊዕ ክንደይ ዋግኡ?
Somali: Idahan buuran ee diyaarka u ah munaasabadda ciidda waa immisa?

English: Do you accept digital payments through Telebirr or mobile banking?
Amharic: በቴሌብር ወይም በሞባይል ባንኪንግ ክፍያ ትቀበላላችሁ?
Afaan_Oromoo: Kaffaltii dijitaalaa karaa Telee-birrii yookaan baankii mobaayilaatiin ni fudhattuu?
Tigrinya: ብቴሌብር ወይስ ብሞባይል ባንኪንግ ክፍሊት ትቕበሉ ዶ?
Somali: Ma aqbashaa lacag-bixinta casriga ah ee Telebirr ama bangiga mobaylka?

English: What time does the morning cross-country bus leave for Bahir Dar?
Amharic: የጠዋቱ የሀገር አቋራጭ አውቶቡስ ወደ ባህር ዳር ስንት ሰዓት ይነሳል?
Afaan_Oromoo: Otobisii ganamaa gara Baahir Daar deemu sa'aatii meeqatti ka'a?
Tigrinya: ናይ ንግሆ ኣውቶቡስ ናብ ባሕሪ ዳር ክንደይ ሰዓት ይብገስ?
Somali: Baska aroortii ee gobollada u socda Bahir Dar goormuu baxayaa?

English: The monolithic rock-hewn churches of Lalibela were built in the twelfth century.
Amharic: ከአንድ ወጥ አለት የተፈለፈሉት የላሊበላ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት የተገነቡት በዐሥራ ሁለተኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን ነው።
Afaan_Oromoo: Manni sagadaa dhagaa qullaa irraa hojjetamee Laallibalaa jaarraa kudha lammaffaa keessa ijaarame.
Tigrinya: ካብ ሓደ ከውሒ ዝተወቕሩ ኣብያተ-ክርስትያን ላሊበላ ኣብ መበል ዓሰርተው ክልተ ክፍለ-ዘመን ዝተሃነጹ እዮም።
Somali: Kaniisadaha taariikhiga ah ee dhagaxa laga qoday ee Lalibela waxaa la dhisay qarnigii laba iyo tobnaad.

English: Axum is renowned worldwide for its ancient stelae and rich historical heritage.
Amharic: አክሱም በጥንታዊ ሀውልቶቿ እና በታላቅ ታሪካዊ ቅርሶቿ በመላው ዓለም ትታወቃለች።
Afaan_Oromoo: Magaalaan Aksum siidaa duriifi seenaa qabeessa ta'een addunyaa gutuurratti beekamti.
Tigrinya: ኣኽሱም ብጥንታውያን ሓወልትታታን ብሃብታም ታሪኻዊ ውርሻታታን ኣብ መላእ ዓለም ፍልጥቲ እያ።
Somali: Magaalada Axum waxay dunida oo dhan ku caanbaxday tiirarka qadiimiga ah iyo dhaxalka taariikhiga ah.

English: Turn right at the roundabout and continue straight past the grand mosque.
Amharic: አደባባዩ ጋር ወደ ቀኝ ታጥፈው ታላቁን መስጊድ አልፈው ቀጥታ ይሂዱ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Rundabootti gara mirgaatti goriitii masgiida guddicha bira darbiitii qajeeli.
Tigrinya: ኣብቲ ኣደባባይ ናብ የማን ተጠዊኹም ነቲ ዓቢ መስጊድ ሓሊፍኩም ብቐጥታ ኺዱ።
Somali: U leexo dhinaca midig wareegga kaddibna si toos ah u dhaaf masaajidka weyn.

English: I lost my Kebele identification card and need a replacement certificate.
Amharic: የቀበሌ መታወቂያ ካርዴ ስለጠፋብኝ ምትክ ማስረጃ እፈልጋለሁ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Waraqaan eenyummaa gandaa koo waan na jalaa badeef ragaa bakka bu'u nan barbaada.
Tigrinya: መለለዪ ወረቐት ቀበለ ስለዝጠፍኣኒ መተካእታ ምስክር ወረቐት የድልየኒ ኣሎ።
Somali: Waxaa iga lumay kaarkii aqoonsiga xaafadda (kebele) waxaanan u baahanahay caddeyn bedel ah.

English: I want to file a police report because my passport and phone were stolen.
Amharic: ፓስፖርቴ እና ስልኬ ስለተሰረቁ የፖሊስ ሪፖርት ማቅረብ እፈልጋለሁ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Paaspoortiin koofi bilbilli koo waan jalaa hatameef gabaasa poolisiitti kennuun barbaada.
Tigrinya: ፓስፖርተይን ሞባይለይን ስለእተሰርቁ ሓበሬታ ናብ ፖሊስ ከቕርብ እደሊ ኣለኹ።
Somali: Waxaan rabaa inaan dacwad boolis gudbiyo maadaama baasaboorkeygii iyo taleefankeygii la xaday.

English: Please sit down, sir, and make yourself comfortable.
Amharic: እባክዎትን ጋሼ ይቀመጡ፣ እንደ ልብዎ ይሁኑ።
Afaan_Oromoo: Maaloo kabajamoo taa'aa, akkuma mana keessaniitti boqodhaa.
Tigrinya: በጃኹም ኣቦይ ተቐመጡ፡ ከም ድላይኩም ድማ ፍቱሓት ኩኑ።
Somali: Fadlan fariiso mudane, oo si fiican u raaxayso.

English: Welcome, sister, how is your health today?
Amharic: እንኳን ደህና መጣሽ እህቴ፣ ዛሬ ጤናሽ እንዴት ነው?
Afaan_Oromoo: Baga nagaan dhufte obboleettii ko, har'a fayyaan kee akkam?
Tigrinya: እንቋዕ ድሓን መጻእኺ ሓፍተይ፡ ሎሚ ጥዕናኺ ከመይ ኣሎ?
Somali: Ku soo dhawoow abaayo, caafimaadkaagu maanta sidee yahay?

English: If the doctor had arrived ten minutes earlier, the surgery would have succeeded.
Amharic: ዶክተሩ አስር ደቂቃ ቀድሞ ደርሶ ቢሆን ኖሮ ቀዶ ጥገናው ይሳካ ነበር።
Afaan_Oromoo: Doktoorichi daqiiqaa kudhan dursitee utuu dhufeera ta'ee, yaalli baqaqsanii hodhuu sun ni milkaa'a ture.
Tigrinya: እቲ ሓኪም ዓሰርተ ደቒቕ ኣቐዲሙ መጺኡ እንተዝነብር፡ እቲ መጥባሕቲ ምሰለኸ ነይሩ።
Somali: Haddii dhakhtarku toban daqiiqo ka hor iman lahaa, qalliinku wuu guuleysan lahaa.
